verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state that although Transaction Aggregation data refreshes daily, developers can trigger a refresh via dedicated 'Data Refresh' endpoints when more recent data is needed, confirming an on-demand refresh capability tied to the API. However, the evidence pack only points to this capability rather than detailing the actual refresh semantics (e.g., sync/async behavior, expected latency, status codes, or webhook completion notification), so the depth of documented semantics is unclear. Missing for 10: detailed refresh endpoint spec/semantics, confirmation of applicability to Account Balance/other data types beyond transactions, and independent corroboration of refresh behavior.
